These products work—not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Why Gabriel Became a Dissident", "body": "Gabriel traces his on-air name to what he recalls as a Bush Senior speech about a thousand points of light and being either with us or against us, a line in the sand he says made the decision for him. He sides with natural law over any claimed divine right to rule and argues there is value in being cast out: they get the material, we get the spiritual. That conviction launched his YouTube channel and its Tarot of the Avengers series, which Chance describes as mapping 22 Marvel movies onto the Major Arcana and Gabriel calls a live record of his own learning."}, {"title": "A Childhood Dancing Spell Comes True", "body": "Through his aunt's magical bookshop in conservative Indiana, a teenage Gabriel learned of an old colonial spell: a broom under the floorboards that would compel an intruder to dance to exhaustion. He links it to the 1518 dancing plague in Strasbourg, where onlookers caught the compulsion, and to capoeira, the ritualistic Afro-Brazilian dance fighting he calls the roots of breakdance. Through sympathetic magic, he says, movement spreads from one body to the next, and he now lives inside that first spell. Chance shares a woodland birthday party where flow artists danced on a shipping container stage."}, {"title": "The Warrior Who Must Also Heal", "body": "Gabriel recounts earning an instructor's badge in taekwondo under Master Myers at the YMCA, then studying aikido, kendo and the Five Rings, where he read that anyone who knows how to do harm must also know how to do remedy. Chance connects this to Aragorn in Tolkien, whose healing hands and kingsfoil save Frodo, Eowyn and Merry. The idea led Gabriel to massage school and to capoeira, whose etiquette keeps the hands for creation and the feet for dirty work, keeps clothes clean, and teaches the maxim of the student who teaches and the master who learns."}, {"title": "Self Defense From the Body to the Psyche", "body": "Gabriel describes padded assailant training, which he first read about in Black Belt Magazine and later practiced in Colorado: facilitators in heavily padded suits lead scenario drills that build from verbal conflict to full force, a place where he says the physical meets the spiritual. He watched his instructor wear the mask of humanity's worst so others could rise as warriors. Chance calls distortion a debugging process for source, offers that derma is an anagram of dream, and argues that psychic self defense is symbolic literacy, with Gabriel adding his ABCs of awareness, boundaries and choice."}, {"title": "Coded Films and the Courtroom Spell", "body": "Chance asks why Hollywood encodes tarot into so much, suggesting it works through sympathetic magic, and the two read the Avengers films, including Thanos's snap, as warnings hidden in plain sight. Gabriel sees the symbols as a disclaimer for those spiritually aware enough to read the signs, and calls the Endgame return of half the population a magical blending of three forces. He then performs his poem Possessed States, which recasts a court appearance as a spell of gavels, black mantles and oath sigils, calling out what he names pharmakeia and dark arts."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Gabriel recently began teaching occult symbolism and tarot on his Youtube channel, Slick Dissident. This guy has a huge range of knowledge to share and in this episode we kick off what will likely be many shows together, as we strengthen our skin to better live our dreams. Difficult to encapsulate in a description, our discussion demonstrates flow as we weave threads through martial arts, dance, tarot, Disney/Marvel, MK Ultra, the cult of castration, poetry, psychic self defense, dream analysis, and much more. It's one you won't soon forget.
